title: Replace Words With Shortest Root
statement: You are given a list of root words and a sentence (a single string of space-separated lowercase words). For each word in the sentence, if some root in the list is a prefix of that word, replace the word with the shortest such root. If no root is a prefix of the word, leave the word unchanged. Return the resulting sentence as a single space-separated string.

args: the cattle was rattled by the battery
tests.expected: the cat was rat by the bat

hints: Checking each word against every root directly is O(words * roots * length); inserting all roots into a trie lets you find the shortest matching root for a word in time proportional to the word's length.

Because insertion visits characters in order and you stop at the first node marked as the end of a root, walking a trie built from all roots naturally finds the shortest prefix match, regardless of the order the roots were given.

Build a trie from roots marking end-of-root nodes. For each sentence word, walk the trie character by character; as soon as you hit a node flagged as an end-of-root, return the prefix consumed so far. If you fall off the trie or never hit an end marker, return the original word.
